preservation_policy: Hard trainingguard only in Nap protected cells; guard<=incumbent*(1+1e-6)+1e-12 is a training acceptance tolerance, not a scientific gate change. K arms have no hardguard; their transfer/regressions are assessed on newdevelopment and unchanged openedstress. All main scientific thresholds unchanged.
rebase_control: nap_rebased_only projects full existing Nap head weights onto reliable feature singular vectors, without trajectory fitting. This isolates legacy cancelling coefficients from the restricted-update conditioning package, which otherwise preserves legacy weights. Same tensor sizes, inference ops and FP32. Full FP64 dynamics probe is unavailable in legacy code; isolated final-reduction32vs64 probes are explicitly scoped and repeated on GPU.

hypotheses.numerical: Large compensating Nap rate weights make materialized FP32 optimization unstable; restricted reliable feature directions improve full-GPU transfer without changing inference.
hypotheses.identification: K inactivation equilibrium and speed compensations differ in history-dependent generalization; separate heads and activationcontrol distinguish them.
hypotheses.preservation: Independent channel/seed acceptance plus fit-guard preservation prevents hidden tradeoffs and acquired regressions.
hypotheses.memory: Matched-history protocols identify slow recovery better than ordinary initial equilibria at matched maximum budget.
hypotheses.derivative: Full materialized recurrence directional finite differences support the Jacobian at resolvable perturbations; FP64 comparison is diagnostic only.

limits: All41n stress is opened diagnostic; selection only newdevelopment.
FP64 model is a numerical probe only, never selectable or used for main inference.
Truncated training subspace preserves inference architecture but can restrict expressivity of a repair; failure is not proof no solution exists.
Protection uses dedicated trainingguard residuals, not scientific threshold relaxation or openedstress labels.
Numerical audit finite directional checks are local, not a proof for every weight/input.
Coverage tests history distribution; no claim that all rare regimes are covered.

quality.normalization: For each trajectory/channel S=max(max_t abs(I_reference),1e-7 mA/cm2). Charge errors divided by duration*S, not near-zero signed target charge. Report absolute errors and peak-relative charge diagnostics as well. No averaging across regimes to waive a failed critical gate.
quality.event_support: Transient timing evaluated only when reference peak-baseline contrast >=25% of S, peak >=10*floor, and peak is internal to the window. Other cases explicitly not_evaluable; amplitude/current gates still apply. Onset/offset use 10% of reference transient amplitude. Multi-event morphology needs dedicated matching in closed-loop stage.

Inputs afterinitialization same withinpairs. nap_conditioned_memory uses those pairedhistories in fit; comparator nap_conditioned_protected uses ordinary fitinitials.
